highlights: Update your joined servers to this version too, so that the new workflow tools, owner transfer and the agent fixes work there.
Talk to your agents with push to talk: hold the talk button or the talk key while you speak.
Start a workflow again from one step, and see the settings that made each step result.
Give your server to another OpenBot account in Server Settings > Members.
Restart for an update now waits until your agents are idle, and stuck "working" agents start their waiting messages again.
